record.body: The Signature Complexity Index is an original designed measure modeled on the idea of ACI: it sums how much the loudness in each designed frequency band changes from moment to moment, so a varied designed chorus scores high and a steady designed drone scores low. The index is a Signature invention with stated rules, not the real ACI, and the pair never presents Signature scores as real ACI values from any real site. Like its model, it cannot identify species, and it responds to all three Signature layers, so Signature results are always reported alongside a designed listening check. The pair describes the idea in words and computes example totals in arithmetic, without inventing a false formula for the real index.

demo.code:
TITLE = 'Signature Complexity Index: A Designed Variability Measure'
BANDS = {'band change A': 5, 'band change B': 7, 'band change C': 8}
tot = float(sum(BANDS.values()))
print('Record: ' + TITLE)
print('Total: %d' % int(tot))
for k in sorted(BANDS):
    print('%s: %d (%.1f percent)' % (k, BANDS[k], 100.0 * BANDS[k] / tot))
demo.expected_output:
Record: Signature Complexity Index: A Designed Variability Measure
Total: 20
band change A: 5 (25.0 percent)
band change B: 7 (35.0 percent)
band change C: 8 (40.0 percent)
